title: Online index changes
statement: The system shall build and drop property indexes without blocking concurrent reads or writes.
rationale: Index evolution must not consume the availability budget.

acceptance_criteria.text: Building an index over 100 GiB of graph data under YCSB workload A causes zero failed client requests and OLTP p99 stays within its target +50%.
An in-progress index build can be cancelled and leaves no partial index visible to queries.
